pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Projectile-tagged direct hits on the main body are rejected; sleep and teleportation protect that body too. Separate parts have their own hit route, so this does not establish immunity for every part. Change your aim and attack an exposed part after it moves.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: Separate parts have their own hit route, so this does not establish immunity for every part. This profile does not use hosted preparation. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Large Shulker Shell, shulker shell. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
